claim: The Ehelepola Walauwa Wax Museum currently frames Kandyan history through royal succession, noble administration, Buddhist revival, colonial intermediaries and the martyr-memory of the Ehelepola family.
bounded_by: This establishes the museum's present curatorial selection, not the historical truth, motive or exact wording of every episode represented.
notes: Use as a historiographic and navigation claim only. Museum labels are capped at T3/lead for this run and cannot independently close an event claim.
